body.justification: This question isolates the exact effective geometric package still needed to turn coherent recession operators into a finite globally honest search space.
body.gap: The standing assumptions do not yet yield simultaneous canonical-section safety, collar compatibility, translated-uniform tails, or a refinement schedule whose total ledger vanishes.
body.consumer: Only an affirmative answer, or a separately proved sufficient compatibility package, can supply the finite Gaussian-rule premise needed by conditional CertGluePFL termination and replayable moving-offset certification.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct, or refute by a specific encoded experiment, a finite shared-trace recession library satisfying canonical-section preservation, safety of every positive-weight candidate, simultaneous-collar compatibility, translated-uniform tails, and an input-computable refinement schedule with vanishing accumulated error.
obligation.obstruction: The available active-set geometry controls only forward motion from a fixed mean. It does not prove that canonical sections throughout protected stars preserve every active semantic region and the separated-risk set. Equality of shared mesh vertices on a geometric face does not control the actual face--cone candidates throughout simultaneous collar supports. No translated-uniform guard and normal-base tail bound or explicit refinement-count recurrence has been derived. Hence the standing assumptions currently support neither an affirmative construction nor a negative encoded-experiment witness.
obligation.attempted: The prior construction used one smoothed ancestor, one common rational simplicial fan, common raywise Foelner factors, and shared finite-element face variables. This gives path-independent operators and explicit translation-boundary ratios. The proposed collar induction is circular if its traces are defined from the already-glued rule, while constant lower-skeleton extension can assign positive weight to an unsafe candidate. Per-cell bounds also cannot be summed without controlling the growing refinement count. In accordance with the directive after this barrier was isolated, no further generic averaging reroll was used.
obligation.partial_result:
Starting from the single ancestor \(q_s=K*\phi_{s^2\Sigma}\), \(\mathrm{lem:common\mbox{-}ray\mbox{-}folner\mbox{-}coherence}\) proves that, for every face inclusion \(\tau\preceq\sigma\),
\[
q_{\sigma,L}
=
\left(
\prod_{\varrho\in\mathscr R(\sigma)\setminus\mathscr R(\tau)}
\mathsf A_{\varrho,L}
\right)q_{\tau,L},
\]
independently of the incidence path, together with the bounds
\[
\left\|q_{\sigma,L}(w+a\varrho)-q_{\sigma,L}(w)\right\|_1
\leq 2\min\{1,a/L\}
\]
and
\[
\left|F^f_{\sigma,L}(w+a\varrho)-F^f_{\sigma,L}(w)\right|
\leq R_f\min\{1,a/L\}.
\]
The established smoothing, one-chart averaging, and weighted path results separately give
\[
R_f\min\{1,s^2\sqrt{d/8}\},
\qquad
\frac{R_fk}{T\sqrt{2\pi}},
\qquad
\sum_e\Gamma_{C,e}^f+\frac{R_f}{2}\omega(h)
\]
for each fixed finite library. These identities certify path-independent transitions and the stated componentwise errors only. They do not prove simultaneous safety on collar supports, tails uniform over translated means, or a refinement-count schedule whose accumulated ledger vanishes.
